framing.lineOfInquiry: Abhishek Gill (P00359) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE038
framing.alternate: Abhishek Gill (P00359) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.
